title: Design System: Openfront Med Spa Storefront

accent.note: Runtime: brandHueColor(logoHue, 76%, 0.09) in MainLayout; value shown is the hue-300 fallback.

accent-ink.note: Runtime-derived from the practice logo hue in MainLayout.

accent-soft.note: Runtime-derived from the practice logo hue in MainLayout.

focus.note: Runtime-derived from the practice logo hue in MainLayout.

display.purpose: The practice name in the home hero only.

headline.purpose: Section heads on home and content pages.

title.purpose: Treatment ledger names; provider names on portrait cards.

title-s.purpose: State titles and the booking calendar date numerals.

lead.purpose: Intro paragraphs, max 54ch in Soft Ink.

body.purpose: Running text, buttons, chips and inputs.

label.purpose: Italic side notes and labels, sentence case, never tracked capitals.

figures.purpose: Tabular lining figures for prices, durations, hours and counts.

shadows.name: fold-crease
shadows.purpose: The only elevation: a 1px light crease along the top edge of every fold (--sf-fold).

shadows.name: ledger-crease
shadows.purpose: Bottom border between treatment ledger lines (a printed menu rule).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All storefront transitions and the unfold entrance.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on pills and cards.

motion.name: unfold
motion.value: 640ms; from opacity 0, clip-path inset(0 0 60% 0), translateY(-8px); stagger 70ms, cap 260ms
motion.purpose: Hero columns and ledger rows open once on arrival; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The booking action, filled in the practice hue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--sf-font-display, 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--sf-radius-sm, 4px); background: var(--sf-accent, oklch(76% 0.09 300)); color: var(--sf-accent-ink, oklch(17% 0.03 300)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--sf-accent, oklch(76% 0.09 300)) 86%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sf-focus, oklch(80% 0.1 300)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fold Button
components.description: Default action: a Third Fold tab that darkens when pressed.

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: var(--sf-font-display, 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif); display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(22% 0.009 70); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1); color: oklch(94.5% 0.012 82); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-card:hover { background: oklch(24.5% 0.01 70); } .ds-card:active { background: oklch(20.5% 0.009 70); } .ds-card-t { font-size: 1.3125rem; } .ds-card-m { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(67% 0.012 78); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Second Fold field with a Strong Rule stroke and a hue ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--sf-font-display, 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif); display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(80% 0.013 80); } .ds-input { font: inherit; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid oklch(40% 0.01 70); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(20.5% 0.009 70); color: oklch(94.5% 0.012 82); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; transition: border-color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(67% 0.012 78); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(76% 0.09 300); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(28% 0.05 300); }

components.name: Treatment Ledger Row
components.description: Printed-menu line: Garamond name, italic category, tabular figures in one column.
components.html: Glow chemical peelFacials & peels45 min$140
components.css: .ds-ledger { font-family: var(--sf-font-display, 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; padding: 1.125rem 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1); color: oklch(94.5% 0.012 82); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), padding-inline 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-ledger:hover { padding-inline: 0.75rem; background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.03); } .ds-ledger:active { background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.22); } .ds-ledger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(80% 0.1 300); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ledger-n { display: block; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-ledger-c { display: block; font-size: 1rem; font-style: italic; color: oklch(67% 0.012 78); } .ds-ledger-f { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 5.5rem auto; gap: 1.5rem; justify-items: end; align-items: baseline; font-size: 1.3125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-ledger-d { color: oklch(80% 0.013 80); } .ds-ledger svg { align-self: center; color: oklch(67% 0.012 78); }

narrative.overview:
The storefront is a stack of charcoal-dyed spa linen. The page is the darkest fold. Every band, card, pill and fact sits one fold up, a tone lighter, and its top edge catches the light in a single 1px crease. Depth comes from tone and that crease alone: nothing is outlined, nothing glows, nothing blurs. Colour arrives as whole flat fields of linen dyed in the practice's hue, never as a wash or gradient.

One face, EB Garamond, sets everything, from the 136px practice name to the tabular prices. Its italic carries the side notes and labels. The treatment menu reads like a printed annual: names on the left, figures in one tabular column on the right, a crease between lines. Layout registers against one off-centre axis (42/58 on the home hero) rather than a centred hero.

The density is calm but factual. Treatment facts (duration, price, provider) sit beside the names in full-size figures, not behind a hover. The accent belongs to the practice: its logo hue is resolved at runtime, so no storefront hardcodes a brand colour.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal ground (hue 70) with three fold tones and a white 10% crease along each fold's top edge.
A single accent derived from the practice's logo hue, used for the primary action, dyed bands and the focus ring.
EB Garamond only (vendored, OFL, roman and italic, variable 400–800), with lining figures everywhere and tabular figures for numbers.
Small, soft corners (4, 6, 8px). No pills at 999px, no circles.
Folds open once as they arrive (clip from the top) and darken a tone when pressed.

rules.name: The Practice Owns the Hue Rule
rules.body: The accent is always derived from the practice's logo hue at runtime. Never hardcode a hue into a component; reference the accent tokens.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: Colour comes as a whole flat field: a dyed band, a filled primary button. No gradients, radial glows or washes anywhere in the storefront.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: EB Garamond sets everything. Do not introduce a sans, a mono or a system display face.

rules.name: The Side Note Rule
rules.body: Small labels are italic at 16px in sentence case. Never tracked uppercase capitals.

rules.name: The Figure Column Rule
rules.body: Numbers are tabular lining figures and align in one right-hand column (ledger figures are a fixed `auto 5.5rem auto` grid).

rules.name: The Fold Rule
rules.body: A surface is raised by being one tone lighter with a crease on its top edge, never by an outline, drop shadow, glow or blur.

rules.name: The Press Darkens Rule
rules.body: Pressing a fold drops it a tone (to Second Fold, or to black 22% on a ledger row). Hover lifts it a tone.

dos: **Do** raise a surface by one fold tone plus the crease (`inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1)`).
**Do** derive every accent from the practice's logo hue through the `--sf-accent*` tokens.
**Do** set every word in EB Garamond, with italic 16px for side notes and labels.
**Do** align prices, durations and hours as tabular lining figures in one right-hand column.
**Do** use 4px for controls, 6px for frames and wells, 8px for cards.
**Do** mark a chosen pill, step or date with a Linen White fill and Night Linen text.
**Do** use hairline rules only between list lines (ledger, hours, footer), under text links, and around text fields.
donts: **Don't** outline cards, options, chips or pills; the fold is the edge.
**Don't** use drop shadows, glows, gradients, radial washes or backdrop blur.
**Don't** use tracked uppercase labels or a second typeface.
**Don't** use fully rounded 999px pills or circular frames; corners stop at 8px.
**Don't** hardcode a brand hue or a bone or blush light ground; the ground is Night Linen.
**Don't** show an empty image placeholder where a photo is missing; omit the frame.
